evidenceSummary: Review covers 28 physical repositories. The shared local foundation is implemented across all seven consumer apps; 698 app tests, 90 shared-package tests, clean analyzers and both local native release builds pass. Shared packages are now pinned to published App-Template commit d2895cba9ac5bc121369a409fb1e528071a98a2d with actual Git-source checks; physical-device and native-store qualification remain pending; dated historical reports keep their original scope.

repositories.name: .github
repositories.status: Organization governance and generated portfolio inventory now record the implemented shared foundation and retained local validation evidence.
repositories.next: Maintain the shared-foundation adoption/qualification gate, unchanged product queue, honest evidence records and reproducible local validation.
repositories.concern: Private-repository branch protection, secret scanning, and push protection remain accepted GitHub Free risks; hosted Actions are optional.

repositories.name: Fine-Notes

repositories.status: Local tasting vault uses shared encrypted SQLite with legacy-envelope compatibility, native privacy/locking, encrypted selected-note sharing, full owner backup/recovery and native permanent unlock.
repositories.launchEvidence: Current shared-foundation analysis/tests and Android/unsigned iOS release builds pass; original encrypted-note and full-vault readers are retained.
repositories.next: Finish physical recovery/privacy, native store qualification, then large-collection, selected-sharing, accessibility, signing and store QA.
repositories.concern: Large/low-memory vault and physical-device reliability, store transactions and release approval remain pending; no remote valuation or diagnosis is provided.
repositories.targetDataModel: Keep wine, whiskey, coffee, and cigars in one local tasting app; deliberate encrypted sharing, manual valuations, and permanent local premium unlock.

repositories.name: App-Template

repositories.next: Finish representative physical-device/store qualification before any app release; maintain the published immutable foundation, generator and common contracts through deliberate updates.
repositories.concern: Private Git access is required to resolve the published shared packages. Local compilation and simulator/emulator evidence do not establish physical-device/store qualification.
